title: Cut-off estimates at a reduced-boundary point: annular bounds and upper density (De Giorgi; Simon 4.3 (1), (3)–(6))
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ. Suppose D ⊆ ℝ^{m+1} is open, F ⊆ ℝ^{m+1} is Borel, μ is a Borel measure on ℝ^{m+1} with μ(ℝ^{m+1} \ D) = 0 and μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ D, ν : ℝ^{m+1} → ℝ^{m+1} is Borel with |ν(z)| = 1 for every z, and the Gauss–Green identity (GG) ∫_F div φ dL^{m+1} = −∫⟨φ, ν⟩ dμ holds for every C¹ compactly supported φ : ℝ^{m+1} → ℝ^{m+1} with tsupport φ ⊆ D (div φ = trace Dφ, L^{m+1} = volume). Let y ∈ D and v ∈ ℝ^{m+1} with |v| = 1 be such that the normal averages A(ρ) := μ(B̄_ρ(y))_ℝ^{-1} ∫_{B̄_ρ(y)} ν dμ converge to v as ρ ↓ 0 (μ(·)_ℝ = ENNReal.toReal, 0^{-1} = 0). Then there are ρ₁ > 0 and C ≥ 0 with B̄_{ρ₁}(y) ⊆ D such that for all ρ, δ > 0 with ρ + δ < ρ₁: δ·μ(B̄_ρ(y)) ≤ C·L^{m+1}(F ∩ (B_{ρ+δ}(y) \ B̄_ρ(y))) and δ·μ(B̄_ρ(y)) ≤ C·L^{m+1}((B_{ρ+δ}(y) \ B̄_ρ(y)) \ F); and μ(B̄_ρ(y)) ≤ C ρ^m for all 0 < ρ < ρ₁.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (D F : Set (Euclid (m + 1))) (μ : Measure (Euclid (m + 1))) (ν : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1)) (y v : Euclid (m + 1)), IsOpen D → MeasurableSet F → μ Dᶜ = 0 → (∀ K : Set (Euclid (m + 1)), IsCompact K → K ⊆ D → μ K ≠ ∞) → Measurable ν → (∀ z, ‖ν z‖ = 1) → (∀ φ : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1), ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ D → ∫ z in F, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ φ z : Euclid (m + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid (m + 1)) = -∫ z, inner ℝ (φ z) (ν z) ∂μ) → y ∈ D → ‖v‖ = 1 → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => (μ (closedBall y ρ)).toReal⁻¹ • ∫ z in closedBall y ρ, ν z ∂μ) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 v) → ∃ ρ₁ C : ℝ, 0 < ρ₁ ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧ closedBall y ρ₁ ⊆ D ∧ (∀ ρ δ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → 0 < δ → ρ + δ < ρ₁ → ENNReal.ofReal δ * μ (closedBall y ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C * volume (F ∩ (ball y (ρ + δ) \ closedBall y ρ)) ∧ ENNReal.ofReal δ * μ (closedBall y ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C * volume ((ball y (ρ + δ) \ closedBall y ρ) \ F)) ∧ ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < ρ₁ → μ (closedBall y ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * ρ ^ m)
